title: The Treatise of Mastered Strength
summary: A treatise for the student past the primers that settles the stance and adds blows that stagger and overbear a target.

title: A Canon of the Hammering Body
summary: A canon that makes the whole body a hammer through a steady beat of blows and ends with the shattering beat.

title: Canon of Strength Beyond the Body
summary: A canon on letting the qi field carry the force of a fist past the hand and into a target out of reach.

title: The Colossus Frame Course
summary: A course that builds a frame of giant mass and uses it to crush and to answer blows with towering force.

title: The Twin Pillar Strength Treatise
summary: A treatise on standing as two pillars with both arms and legs working as a pair to crush and to rebuke.

title: Manual of the Basin Hold
summary: A manual on gathering force in the body like water in a basin and loosing it all at once in an overflowing blow.

title: The Paired Giant Compendium
summary: A compendium of two-handed giant strokes where both fists fall together and the qi field doubles the weight.

title: The Wind-Sworn Strength Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of strength sworn to an oath of steadiness that clears the body of fear and breaks guards on a held bearing.

title: The Oath of the Planted Foot
summary: A sworn manual of the planted foot that never gives ground and answers every blow from a deep root.

title: Treatise of the Held Bearing
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing and holding it against every force until the blow that ends the exchange.
